stem:
Mona and Nitin each start with the same whole chapati. Mona cuts hers into 4 equal pieces. Nitin cuts his into 4 pieces of different sizes. Each takes one piece and calls it one-fourth of the chapati.

Whose piece is a valid fractional unit of one-fourth?

options.text: Only Mona's piece, because the parts must be equal in size.
Both pieces, because each chapati was cut into 4 pieces.
Only Nitin's piece, because unequal shapes still make fourths.
Neither piece, because fourths must be triangles.

teacher.key_rationale: A fractional unit 1/n requires the whole to be partitioned into n equal-size parts. Only Mona's equal pieces give a valid one-fourth.
